title: MegaMeal Experience Review
description: A brief post-consumption satisfaction review for valued consumers, meat donors, and survivors.

OUTCOME_DELIGHTED.title: Status: Optimally Conditioned Consumer
OUTCOME_DELIGHTED.description: Your responses indicate a healthy level of corporate obedience, appetite tolerance, and voluntary emotional surrender. You are exactly the kind of satisfied organism our investors dream about. Please continue consuming until instructed otherwise.

OUTCOME_CONCERNING.title: Status: Customer Retention Risk
OUTCOME_CONCERNING.description: You have expressed potentially counterproductive levels of hesitation, free will, or digestive concern. A Loyalty Recovery Specialist may be dispatched to your residence with pamphlets, coupons, and tranquilizing aerosols. Thank you for your honesty. It will be used against you.

OUTCOME_TRANSCENDENT.title: Status: Fully Integrated Into The Hunger Grid
OUTCOME_TRANSCENDENT.description: Your feedback suggests that you no longer distinguish between dining, devotion, and irreversible transformation. This is outstanding. You have crossed beyond customer satisfaction and entered the premium tier of sacred brand symbiosis. Keep glowing. Keep chewing.

OUTCOME_DEFAULT.title: Status: Survey Corrupted By Meat Noise
OUTCOME_DEFAULT.description: Your answers formed an unstable slurry of terror, enthusiasm, and administrative ambiguity. We were unable to determine whether you loved the experience, feared it, or became part of it. Please try again after a short rinse cycle.

q1.text: How would you rate the aroma of your MegaMeal upon first unsealing the containment pouch?

options.text: Like childhood nostalgia blended with regulated chemicals. Comforting.
Aggressively wet. I respected it immediately.
It smelled like a lawsuit trying to hatch.

q2.text: During consumption, how much of your personality remained your own?

options.text: Most of it, though the sauce did make several compelling arguments.
Roughly half. The rest now belongs to the brand family.
None. I was blessed by the paste.

q3.text: Which follow-up service feels most valuable to you as a MegaMeal customer?

options.text: A satisfaction coupon and maybe a quiet room.
A medical consultation, witness protection, or both.
Immediate absorption into the Infinite Hunger of the Masses.
